project_description: Add OpenResponses 2026-04-24 as a distinct versioned protocol surface: a client-facing HTTP, SSE, compaction, and WebSocket frontend plus a dependency-free generic backend connector for remote OpenResponses providers and routers, with ordered item fidelity, proxy-owned continuation state, capability-gated extensions, independent OpenResponses refclient and refbackend emulators, exhaustive Cartesian frontend-to-backend compatibility coverage, official conformance evidence, and no regression to existing protocol adapters.
